author: China Insights
description:
Will 2026 be the year Xi Jinping’s Chinese Dream falls apart? A clear look at the three big weak spots of the Chinese Communist Party! Outside, strong enemies are tearing down their plans. Inside, officials are just giving up! A U.S. report shows the weak points in how the Chinese Communist Party manages its nuclear warheads. Their friends are either caught alive or killed…

China Insights delivers sharp, data-driven analysis of China’s politics, economy, and society.
We connect the dots behind breaking headlines — from Beijing’s power shifts to global market trends — helping viewers understand the real forces shaping modern China.
Stay informed. Stay ahead.
title: Will 2026 be the year Xi Jinping’s Chinese Dream collapses? 3 key CCP weak spots
